cases.title: toolgate dev serves the artifact over stdio and Streamable HTTP
cases.when: toolgate dev (or the build-tool task) starts and a client connects with 2026-07-28 and then 2025-11-25
then: Both versions list and call the tools

cases.title: toolgate dev --digests reports descriptor digests
cases.when: toolgate dev --digests runs for the vector tools
then: Digests equal the packaged descriptor digests

cases.title: toolgate check fails when toolgate.dev.json is tracked
cases.when: toolgate.dev.json is committed to git, then ignored

cases.title: toolgate.dev.json values are validated against declarations
cases.when: dev.json has an unknown global, a wrongly typed global and an undeclared destination

cases.title: dev.json claims are read only in development mode
cases.when: dev.json has claims and TOOLGATE_MODE is production, then development
then: development: fixture claims used and results marked as fixture

cases.title: Examples run in check and need no network
cases.when: toolgate check runs examples, one of which calls a route without a recorded exchange
then: The other fails for missing a recorded mock exchange

cases.title: ToolHarness runs tools with mock egress
cases.when: A test uses ToolHarness with a recorded exchange
then: The tool runs in test mode and route calls are recorded by route id and variables

cases.title: Build integrations expose dev, package and check
cases.when: The language build integration is invoked: Gradle and Maven, toolgate CLI, package.json config, MSBuild
then: Each has dev, package and check entry points
